title: @pyqvault_ · Physics, visualised #5 (predict-first): squeeze an insulated gas, its temperature? (dark, trap)

captions.instagram:
Squeeze a gas to half its volume in an insulated cylinder. Its temperature? A same · B hotter · C colder
Comment your guess before you watch 👇

Class 11 Physics · Thermodynamics
Physics, visualised #5

Insulated, the work you do on the gas has nowhere to go, so it turns into heat: 300 K → 476 K.
The same squeeze in water: the heat flows out and it stays at 300 K.
Insulated (adiabatic): T·V^(γ−1) stays constant, so halving V raises T by 2^(2/3) ≈ 1.59× (γ = 5/3).
That's why a bicycle pump gets hot → B.
